examples.text: Given these three quarterly reports, identify which business segments drove the change in gross margin and explain the causal chain step by step.
Our checkout conversion dropped 12% after the March release. Work backwards through the funnel and tell me which changes could plausibly explain it and how to distinguish between them.
If we shift half of our batch workloads to spot instances, trace the downstream effects on cost, reliability, and on-call burden, and tell me where the second-order risks are.
Refactor this service into a hexagonal architecture and explain the trade-offs of each boundary you draw.
We have a distributed monolith with circular dependencies between four services. Propose a decomposition strategy, the order to execute it in, and how to keep the system releasable throughout.
Review this event-sourced aggregate for consistency violations under concurrent writes and propose a fix that preserves the existing event history.
Read these five vendor contracts and produce a comparison of termination clauses, liability caps, and data residency commitments, flagging anywhere the terms conflict with each other.
Synthesize the findings across these research papers into a coherent narrative, noting where the authors disagree and which claims are supported by the strongest evidence.
Summarize this 200-page regulatory filing into an executive brief that preserves every obligation with a compliance deadline.
The stakeholder wants the dashboard to feel faster but has not defined faster. Enumerate the plausible interpretations, what each would cost to build, and how you would decide between them.
Turn this vague feature request into a specification, listing every assumption you had to make and which ones need confirmation before implementation starts.
We need to support enterprise customers. Work out what that actually implies for authentication, auditing, data isolation, and support commitments, and rank the work by risk.
Prove that this scheduling algorithm terminates and derive its worst-case time complexity, showing each step of the argument.
Derive the closed-form expression for the expected queue depth under this arrival process and explain which assumptions the derivation depends on.
Show whether this distributed consensus protocol satisfies safety under an asynchronous network with one crash failure, and construct a counterexample if it does not.
Compare building this in-house against three vendor options across cost, time to market, lock-in, and operational risk, and make a recommendation with the reasoning made explicit.
We can improve latency, reduce cost, or increase reliability but not all three this quarter. Analyze the trade space and recommend which to pursue given a growth-stage company.
Evaluate migrating from a relational store to an event-driven architecture for this workload, including the cases where the migration would be the wrong call.
